title: Categories section
description: Three rows of category chips that scroll without end, the middle one the other way. Point at a row to stop it; the chip’s icon plays.
pageTitle: Infinite Scrolling Category Chips Section | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it on landing pages for marketplaces, course platforms and stores to show the breadth of what you offer. Three rows scroll endlessly, the middle one in the opposite direction, creating movement without a carousel. Pointing at a row pauses it and plays the chip's icon.
whenToUse.alt: Animated categories section: three rows of scrolling category chips with icons that play on hover

accessibility: Only one copy of each chip is exposed. The looping duplicates are hidden from screen readers and skipped by Tab.
A row stops when one of its chips has keyboard focus, and the focused chip scrolls into view.
Chips are native buttons with visible labels.
iconsNote: The icons in this section use the default Hover state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. Stick with the default animation, as In, Morph and Loop states don’t work well here.

fragments.title: Define the element

fragments.title: A row of chips

fragments.title: Slide by one set, then start over
fragments.note: One number moves the whole row, so the loop never shows a seam.

fragments.title: Slow to a stop, then pick up
fragments.note: A row slows to a stop under the pointer, and picks up again after.
